claim: For a finite family of Gibbs operators and real coefficients, the centered finite BKM self-covariance of the weighted sum of the family CE one-form readouts, evaluated on one Fréchet-induced derivation direction, is nonnegative under the finite Gibbs normalization hypotheses.

carrier.type: FiniteOperatorAlgebra n and Carrier n = (realDerivationsLane (GibbsOperator n)).L; the family is Fin m → GibbsOperator n and each CE readout is the existing Op1Form ℝ Carrier (GibbsOperator n)
operations: finite real linear combination of operator-valued CE one-form readouts
Fréchet derivation direction induced by the existing derivation-to-CE map
conventions: the weighted observable is the operator sum ∑ i, c i • finiteCEOperatorForm n (a i) (finiteCEFrechetDirection D)
the conclusion is the real centered BKM quadratic form of that exact summed operator
no identification with an off-diagonal single-observable Onsager system is asserted
no infinite-dimensional or universal colimit claim is asserted

smallest_gap.description: Apply the already proved finite BKM positivity to the actual operator obtained by summing the weighted CE one-form readouts. This closes positivity of the aggregate quadratic response without asserting a new Onsager-system identification.

out_of_scope: Expansion into an explicit double sum of pairwise family Hessians
Identification of off-diagonal family response with a single-observable Onsager system
Construction of a universal colimit functional
